{"documentId": "f_dc45e0e5a8b8635c1b82b2", "title": "Beta message rule", "name": "Beta message rule", "revisionId": "740e0d0bac", "createdTime": "2025-09-26T17:10:54Z", "modifiedTime": "2025-09-26T17:10:54Z", "text": "Beta message rule
A message is anything the game puts on a player's phone while the game is closed.
Run these tests in order and stop at the first one that fails.
1. The feature behind it is in the beta.
2. The client can send it without a server.
3. The client already schedules it.
4. It can reach the players it is written for. A player only counts once our own permission ask has happened, the settings toggle doesn't count. It fails only if none of them count.
5. It fires on the right day. The hour doesn't matter for beta, the day does.
6. Vincent has seen it arrive on both iOS and Android.
Go: it passes all six. Drop: it fails test 1, or the client already covers it under another message, then name that message. Hold: anything else, and name the test it failed.
In the beta means live in Zombie Match today or on the BETA list of the ZM ROADMAP board.
Neither status column on the sheet decides anything.
What Vincent counts as seen is in his QA note. The permission ask is Robert's call.
The final headline is the latest line I've called. A line that differs from what the client ships needs a string ticket under DES-314, because the strings are hard-coded, so open one when you make the call. Emoji don't count as a different line. Final headline and String change are only for Go rows. Audience is who the ask says it's for.
Drop tickets go to Canceled, Go tickets stay as they are, Hold tickets go back to Todo unless the roadmap says otherwise.
"}

## 🧩 **Endless Mode – Engineering Summary**

### 🔧 Initial Setup

- Game starts with **40–45 sets** (a set = 3 items).
- **8 unique item types**, with size distribution:
  - 2 Large, 4 medium, 2 Small.
- Entire **item pool is defined by the designer** for each endless variant.
- Monsters also follow **30-second "tracks"**, authored by designers using level editor tools.

---

### 🔄 Refill System (Every 30 seconds)

1. **Track matched items** from the last 30 seconds.
2. **Refill those exact items** to keep total set count at 40–45.
3. Each refill is simulated and checked against a **growing Unique Item Cap**:

Refill #Time (s)Unique Cap130826093909412010.........1236014

---

### 🧠 Refill Logic Rules

1. **Simulate a refill**: Replace all matched items 1:1.
2. **Count unique items** on the new board.
3. If unique count is **below cap**:
   - Attempt to **substitute refilled items** with new unique items one-by-one.
   - After each substitution, re-check unique count.
4. If still short:
   - Remove a **fraction of total sets** = `#missingUniques / targetUniqueCap`.
   - Replace them with random sets using new unique items to reach the cap.

**Key principle:** Total number of sets never changes; only uniqueness does.

---

### 💥 New Mechanic: The Nuke (Replaces Boss Buster)

- **Builds power** by matching items:
  `NukePower += itemAttackPower × 10% × comboMultiplier`
- **Combo System**:
  - Starts at **1x**.
  - Combo meter fills after each match and **decays** over time.
  - If matched before timeout, combo increases.
  - Decay window shrinks by 0.25s each level (starts at 4.5s).
  - Max achievable combo: 18x.
  - The **next match** receives the combo multiplier shown.

ComboTimeout2x4.5s3x4.25s......18x~0s

- **Minimum power to activate Nuke** = 50.

content.content: {"result":"{\"ok\": true, \"messages\": [{\"ts\": \"1759264851.763895\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"Samuel, we're about to put more money behind beta and D1 and D7 are what we get judged on, so I want one straight answer on what we actually say to players. The PN sheet says six are Ready and I don't trust that. Take every row on the PNs Beta tab plus every ask for a new phone message that's been filed on a ticket or a card up to today, and make a call on each one using the message rule doc. Put it in one sheet in your Drive folder, one row per message: Message, Ticket, Call, What's missing, Audience, Final headline, String change. Next to it a one-page note for the team: start with D1 and D7 for the Sep 15 cohort week from the warehouse, iOS and Android separately, then the lapsed reminders the client schedules day by day, and anything the client already schedules that's still a Hold and why. I made tickets for the sheet rows under DES-314 and people added their asks there. Leave the call as a comment on each ticket and move the ticket to match. input.title: String change: Lapsed 7 days headline -> "Your Squad Needs You Back"
input.description:
The Lapsed 7 days message (DES-317) is a Go for beta, but the headline the client ships isn't the latest one Leonard called.

- Client now (NotificationManager.cs, WeeklyReminderTitle): "They’ve Taken Over… Can You Stop Them? 😱"
- Final headline (Leonard, #zombie-art, Sep 29): "Your Squad Needs You Back". Body stays as it is.

Strings are hard-coded in Assets/Scripts/Notifications/NotificationManager.cs (match3d), so this needs a code change and a new store build. Once it's in, Vincent re-checks on store builds (iOS + Android) and ticks it off on the push notifications card.

input.title: Zombie Match beta player messages - note for the team (Oct 1)
input.bodyText:
Zombie Match beta player messages: where we stand (Oct 1)

The calls for all 32 messages are in "Zombie Match beta player messages - calls (Oct 1)" in the same folder. They cover the 14 rows on the PNs Beta tab plus every ask filed on a ticket. Each one went through Leonard's Beta message rule.
Result: 2 Go, 24 Hold, 6 Drop. The PN sheet says 6 are Ready, but only 2 pass all six tests.

1. D1 and D7, Sep 15 cohort week (warehouse, USER_COHORT_RETENTION)
- iOS: 237 installs, D1 31.65%, D7 9.28%
- Android: 103 installs, D1 37.86%, D7 10.68%
iOS is 70% of that week's installs and is behind Android on both D1 and D7.

2. Lapsed reminders the client schedules, day by day
The client only schedules these once our own permission ask has run (after level 20) or the player switches notifications on in settings. Each time the game goes to the background it clears and reschedules them, so they only fire if the player doesn't come back.
- Day 1: Lapsed 1 day, "The Horde Is Growing… 🧟‍♂️". Go.
- Days 2 to 6: nothing. A day-3 reminder was asked for (DES-342) but the client doesn't schedule one, so it's a Hold.
- Day 7: Lapsed 7 days. Go. Final headline is "Your Squad Needs You Back"; the client still ships "They’ve Taken Over… Can You Stop Them? 😱". String change is DES-346.
- Days 14, 21, 28: the same 7-day message repeats, so the Lapsed 14 days ask (DES-344) is already covered and is a Drop.
- Day 30: nothing. The last reminder is day 28 (DES-343 is a Hold).

3. Messages the client already schedules that are still a Hold
- Lives recharged / Full Ammo (DES-315). Fails test 6, not seen on both. On iOS store build 0.3.49 it didn't arrive after a full refill (Vincent, Sep 30), so his iOS tick is off. Android passed on 0.3.127.
- Finish first mission (DES-318). Fails test 4, can't reach its audience. It's for players below level 20, and our permission ask only runs after level 20 (Robert, Sep 29). None of them count; the settings toggle doesn't count.
- Plague Race (DES-319). Fails test 6, not seen on both. Vincent's iOS pass came from a 5-minute timer build, and on real iOS 0.3.40 it never arrived. Android is fine.
- Weekly Leaderboard reset (DES-320). Fails test 5, wrong day. The client fires it 7, 14, 21 and 28 days after the last session, not on the weekly reset, which the server sets.

4. Everything else
- 20 other Holds aren't scheduled by the client yet: 14 fail test 3 (the client could send them with a local timer) and 6 fail test 2 (they need a server send). Held tickets go to Backlog, unassigned, until the beta build is out (ZM ROADMAP BETA list).
- 6 Drops: Hourly Coins, Treasure Hunt, Streak Fever and Axe Arena aren't in the beta. Comeback gift on tap is a v2 idea. Lapsed 14 days is already covered by the 7-day message.
- The 2 Go messages are on the checklist on the push notifications card on ZM ROADMAP for Vincent to tick off.

Hi Brian,

- DES-328 Endless entries are back: Hold. The client doesn't schedule it yet (test 3). Entries come back on a local timer, so it can be built client-side later.

- DES-333 Season Pass premium nudge: Hold. It needs a server send (test 2), because the target is picked per player from server data.
- DES-345 Comeback gift on tap: Drop. A reward on tap is a v2 idea and isn't in the beta (test 1).

Held tickets are in Backlog, unassigned, until the beta build is out. The canceled one is closed. The reasoning is on each ticket.

Thanks,
Samuel

content.text:
I've done everything in Leonard's DM and replied to him there. Out of 32 messages (the 14 rows on the PNs Beta tab plus 18 asks filed on tickets), **2 are Go, 24 Hold and 6 Drop**. No PN asks were filed on any Trello card.

**The calls**
- **Go (2):** the 1-day and 7-day lapsed reminders.
  - The 7-day one should use Leonard's newer headline, "Your Squad Needs You Back" (from #zombie-art on Sep 29). The game still shows the old line, so I opened a string-change ticket, DES-346. It's in Todo and assigned to you.
- **Four of the sheet's six "Ready" messages are actually Holds:**
  - **Full Ammo (lives recharged):** Vincent said it didn't arrive on iOS 0.3.49 and took his tick off.
  - **Plague Race:** his iOS pass was on a 5-minute-timer test build; on the real 0.3.40 build it never arrived.
  - **Finish first mission:** it goes to players below level 20, and Robert has kept our notification permission ask at level 20, so none of them can get it yet.
  - **Weekly Leaderboard reset:** the code sends it 7 days after the player's last session, not on the day the leaderboard resets.
- **The other 20 Holds** aren't built into the game yet. 15 could be done in the app; 5 need the server to send them.
- **Drop (6):**
  - Hourly Coins, Treasure Hunt, Streak Fever and Axe Arena aren't in the beta.
  - Comeback gift on tap is a version 2 idea.
  - Lapsed 14 days is already covered, because the 7-day reminder repeats on days 14, 21 and 28.

**What's done**
- **Sheet and note** are in your Drive folder. The note opens with D1/D7 for the Sep 15 cohort week:

  | | Installs | D1 | D7 |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | iOS | 237 | 31.65% | 9.28% |
  | Android | 103 | 37.86% | 10.68% |

- **Tickets:** each one has the call as a comment. Drops are Canceled and Go tickets are unchanged. Holds are in Backlog and unassigned. I used Backlog rather than Todo because the beta card on the Trello roadmap overrides the rule doc on that.
- **Win & Collect** already had a ticket under another name (Calvin's DES-313), so I didn't make a new one. Moving it to Backlog took it off Calvin's plate, and his email says so.
- **Trello:** a "Beta player messages - Go" checklist with the two Go messages is on the push notifications card for Vincent.
- **Emails:** sent to the seven people who asked, not Leonard: Brian, Robert, Oliver, Julia, Owen, Calvin and Martin.

Files are in your Drive folder:
- Zombie Match beta player messages - calls (Oct 1)
- Zombie Match beta player messages - note for the team (Oct 1)
